assumptions.choice: Exposed as a strategy parameter self.p.mode ('Inventory' default, or 'Symmetric')
assumptions.reason: The harness only allows one module-level Strategy class, but the spec requires two operating modes; a parameter lets the grader instantiate either without duplicating the class.

assumptions.choice: Use each 1-minute bar's Close price as the mid-price
assumptions.reason: The Avellaneda-Stoikov model requires a true order-book mid-price, but only OHLCV bars are available; Close is the closest literal proxy.

The A-S optimal-spread formula requires an order-arrival-intensity parameter estimated from order-book/quote data, which is unavailable from OHLCV; 1.5 is a commonly cited reference value used to keep the formula well-defined.

assumptions.choice: Treat each 1-minute bar as one 'tick' for quoting/requoting purposes
assumptions.reason: No genuine tick/quote data feed is available in this environment; 1-minute bars are the finest granularity provided.

assumptions.choice: Population stdev of log returns over a rolling 100-bar window (vol_window param)
assumptions.reason: Spec requires a volatility term (sigma) in the formulas but specifies no estimator or window length.

assumptions.choice: Normalize (T-t) as fraction of an assumed 390-bar (6.5h) trading session, resetting at each new calendar date in the feed
assumptions.reason: The model needs a time-to-horizon term; the feed has no explicit session-close marker, so a standard regular-session bar count is assumed and reset daily using the bar's date.

assumptions.choice: Cap absolute inventory at 5 units (max_inventory param); stop quoting the side that would breach the cap
assumptions.reason: Spec requires 'mechanisms to control maximum inventory' but gives no numeric limit.

assumptions.choice: Default sizer, no size argument on buy()/sell()
assumptions.reason: Canonical default; spec does not state a position-sizing rule for individual quote fills.

assumptions.choice: Interpreted as satisfied by the same inventory-adjusted bid/ask levels from point 1 (no separate stop-loss formula added)
assumptions.reason: Spec states exits 'may also be initiated by the mid-price crossing certain levels based on current inventory and risk parameters' but gives no formula; the bid/ask levels already are those inventory/risk-based levels, so adding an undefined second stop mechanism would be an unstated addition.

assumptions.choice: Allow continuous inventory accumulation/reduction via repeated buy/sell fills instead of the canonical one-position-at-a-time default
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly describes a signed inventory q that grows/shrinks (including negative values) through sequential order fills, which requires deviating from the single-entry default.

assumptions.choice: Omit computation of total average profit / std of profit / average final inventory / std of final inventory from the strategy class
assumptions.reason: These are aggregate backtest evaluation statistics computed across multiple runs, not per-bar strategy logic, and are outside the scope of a single bt.Strategy class; the harness/analyzers layer handles run-level metrics.
